	Lower: You can't seem to steady your vision, almost as if the presence of this being is disrupting the functions of your body. You feel your connection to magic and temporal energy fading slowly.

#### Cut to fight! (MARKER 1)
Music: [Shadowfell Combat](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dFcpLPBGHqg)
Ivys, Roll initiative! Ivys, as you steady yourself to fight, you realize the bloody gash in your chest, is not just a flesh wound, there is a temporal rift in your bloody gash. You look up at your friend Reister, his eyes glazed over like pure steel, as if he is in some kind of trance. 

DURING FIGHT: Azrael reaches out and shadowy skeletal hands wrap around your throat, raising you from the ground and throwing you into the wall of mirrors, shattering the glass and sending you tumbling onto the ground of the village. Reister shudders as the hand grips him, he begins to seize and convulse, and then suddenly he compresses into a metal orb no larger than the palm of your hand. 

#### After 3 rounds of combat
You hear thumps of boots as multiple people can be heard running towards you all, (those who are on their way, what are you doing, how fast are we running?) Melantha and the gang arrives! 
As soon as Melantha draws her sword Azrael will recoil and scream out, "A Celestial vestige... You bring a dead god to fight death, fine. You win today Timekeeper, but I will be back." He fades into a cloud of black smoke and disappears, with a whistle. 

Ivys, as the fight ends, you collapse, falling unconscious as the temporal rift takes up a third of your torso. He begins to seize on the ground as the wound festers magically. [[The Replicant Soul]]

Ivys comes to eventually, the wound closing slowly, the rift collapsing in on itself and he is completely healed. 

Fiona is in shock, "Did you guys just get in a fight with death? Like death death?"
Alabaster just kinda shrugs, "It's actually not that crazy compared to the rest of the stuff they get up to..."

Let them RP, use Fiona and Alabaster to move the convo forward if you have to. 
Eventually, a thundering set of hooves can be heard galloping towards them on the street, Brakk on horseback holding a scroll. 

"My lady, urgent news, from the King himself, please you must read this." He hands Melantha a scroll as he falls to one knee before you. 
Melantha, you take the scroll, and it has a red wax seal of the king, you open it and it reads: [[Adrithyr's Call to War]]

They hear the stuff Melantha tells them, head back to the Castle to rest as it is getting very late, around 11 already. You should probably go get a long rest. 

#### Night time
Melantha, can you roll me 3d20, give me each roll one by one.

#### The next morning
Music: [Castle Ambiance](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BwV1azM1Ifw)
In the morning you all wake up, Maple joins you guys for breakfast, Evan and Mushy enjoying their breakfast salad. You can hear the hustle and bustle of the castle around you as soldiers march through the halls and noble ladies gossip on the happening over the last few days. But you begin to notice, that, even as the morning draws on, 15 minutes, 20 minutes, Melantha and Alabaster are nowhere to be found. 

If they search Melantha and Alabaster's room:
- The room is a ghastly sight. There is blood smeared across the walls, the tables and chairs are broken, the room looks as if there was a battle or fight of dire consequence. 
Maple:
- "I figured they went to meet someone like the King or went training, or at least that you all knew where they were."
- Upon discovering the room in its crazy state: "By the light of Illuman... what happened?"

Evan:
- "I didn't hear anything last night, our guards haven't reported anything, should we confer with the castle guards, maybe the Hyperion Knights?"
- "I'll confer with their captain, in the meantime you need to investigate here, use magic or something." Evan departs with Mushy.

Basically let them investigate and ask whatever they want, here's some lines based on who they talk to:

**Tlaloc**: "One of my apprentices, Cam, saw two individuals riding west at great haste in the dead of night. He couldn't make out much other than that one had a massive sword on their back, they were cloaked and riding with extreme haste."

**Brakk**: "My men reported sounds during the night, we uhm, well we thought it was... something else (he says shyly). I've already dispatched scouts to find our Champion. You should be aware there has been... disturbing energy in our prayers. Whatever happened, Vulcan is far from pleased."

**Tyran**: "I... I don't know. I don't know what she did for certain, but I made a promise. Please let me keep it. I'm trying to be better, let me have my word at least."

Let them investigate and shit, wing the rest, eventually it'll be time for [[The War Council]]
